svg.title: The per-site scenario family
svg.desc: The start files and events files every site gets, and how they pair: an empty garage is filled, a full garage is drained, a single manual AGV visits every node.

g.text: No *_events_fill_and_drain file is among the scenario files: the standardized test refers to a file that is not there.

g.text: Each site gets the same set of files. Start files carry the layout, the initial state and timed set-up events; events files carry the workload and are fed by exercise_sim_events.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Pecos sandbox_eng, sandbox_qa and sandbox_combined (and 275_sunrise_b) follow this pattern.
